text:
The Wexcombe Museum now holds the Aldermoor hoard, 1,327 items in total.

The transfer was confirmed on 14 March 2024. Dr. Imelda Tarrowby, Head of Acquisitions at the museum, announced it.

The collection includes silver coins, torcs and brooches. Custody rests on the Aldermoor Hoard Custody Agreement, signed at a public ceremony at Wexcombe Town Hall.

**By the numbers**

- Items transferred: 1,327
- Confirmed: 14 March 2024
- Holder: Wexcombe Museum

**What it means for the sector**

A single institution now controls a large, varied archaeological collection. That should strengthen Wexcombe's position when it negotiates loans, partnerships and exhibition slots with peer museums.

Custody also brings obligations. Conservation, storage and cataloguing of more than a thousand objects will weigh on budgets, and rivals will watch how Wexcombe handles public access. Collections of this scale tend to draw visitors, and visitor numbers feed funding cases.
